mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId}

SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_image, oi.quantity, oi.current_price, CASE WHEN pr.review_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_reviewed, pr.review_id, pr.rating, pr.content FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_review pr ON pr.order_id = oi.order_id AND pr.product_id = oi.product_id AND pr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.item_id
